chapter: Class 7 Science, Ch 10 Life Processes in Plants (Curiosity)

anatomy.opening: Have you ever seen plants eating food like animals do? (p.137); four children guess what makes plants grow (p.138)

concepts.title: Plants need sunlight and water to grow
concepts.idea: A plant kept in sunlight with water grows best; without water it dies; in the dark it grows poorly.
key_facts: The results indicate that plants require both sunlight and water for their growth.
prompts: Have you observed any changes in a plant during its life span?
children's guesses: water / sunlight / food from soil / maybe ___

misconceptions.belief: Plants take their food from the soil through roots
misconceptions.why_tempting: roots are in soil; fertiliser makes plants grow (the book's own speech bubble)

concepts.prior_knowledge: Grade 6: all living beings grow and need food
local_hooks: yellow grass under a stone or a parked bullock cart
chilli seedlings in the shade of a neem tree stay pale

concepts.title: Leaves make starch; chlorophyll is needed
concepts.idea: Green parts of leaves make food (starch) in sunlight; chlorophyll is essential; leaves are food factories.
key_facts: If the colour of the leaf changes to blue-black, it indicates the presence of starch.
chlorophyll helps in preparing starch in the presence of sunlight

misconceptions.belief: Food is made in the roots
The whole leaf makes food, green or not

local_hooks: croton leaf with green and white patches in a courtyard

activities.title: Let us test some explanations
book_steps: three pots of soil, similar chilli or tomato saplings
A: sun + water; B: sun, no water; C: dark + water
observe two weeks, record height, leaves, colour
activities.expected: A grows best; B may die; C grows poorly and yellows

activities.title: Starch test in a leaf (demonstration activity)
activities.safety: teacher only: boiling water and alcohol near heat (Caution box)
activities.expected: decolourised leaf turns blue-black with iodine
activities.local_substitute: Betadine (povidone-iodine) on a potato slice and cooked rice is safe for students

end_questions.text: A potato slice shows the presence of starch... Where does the starch in potatoes come from?
Krishna set up an experiment with two potted plants...
